mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId,o.store_id AS storeId,o.terminal_id AS terminalId, o.business_date AS businessDate,o.status,o.payment_status AS paymentStatus,o.currency, o.receivable_amount_minor AS receivableAmountMinor,b.quote_fingerprint AS quoteFingerprint, b.settlement_fingerprint AS settlementFingerprint,b.order_snapshot_sha256 AS orderSnapshotSha256 FROM ord_sales_order o LEFT JOIN ord_promotion_binding b ON b.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.order_id=#{orderId}
